Name: Reisha's Natural Furniture
Author: ReishaKinoko
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sQKOUxL.png[/img]
Alternative Textures mod pack of rattan and ocean inspired furniture, a perfect fit for your beach house. Also contains some plushies inspired by Praire King game and Studio Ghibli's films. This is my first mod, I hope you enjoy it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vl3ttj6.png[/img]Just download the mod pack, extract and paste it in the Stardew Valley's Mods folder. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod is required.
I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to decor your home more easily.
